subject: REWRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB347. RULE (cite.py --check 14.9.35.3 'Record-name-1 is the name of a logical record in the file section of the data division and may be qualified.' -> OK, 14.9.35.3 1) -- the same sentence as WRITE 14.9.51.3 SR5, under the same one implementation, StatementValidation.ResolveRecordName. BOTH HALVES ARE WITNESSED. Name-of-a-logical-record: `REWRITE IR-DATA` on a 05 subordinate item and `REWRITE IO-REC(1:3)` on a reference-modified record are both COBOL1757 at every edition, where both used to compile with NO diagnostic and emit CobolFile.Rewrite with an operand of the wrong width -- REWRITE is the verb where that is most destructive, since it REPLACES a record already in the file. May-be-qualified: `REWRITE OUT-REC OF OUTF` binds and replaces the record read, pinned by conformance:cases/14.9.32-RELEASE/pb347_record_name_identity (F1=[999aaaaa] after a READ of 111aaaaa and a MOVE of '999' to the key). Edition-invariant, no gate; the negatives carry `*> reject-at: 85 2002 2014 2023`.
